purpose: Define a versioned, deterministic, and fail-closed evidence template for qualified, deployment-specific GDPR applicability, special-category, automated-decision, and DPIA screening. The template does not determine law, lawfulness, an Article 9 condition, an Article 22 outcome, DPIA necessity, authority, processing activation, release, or runtime operation.

authoritative_external_reference.screening_references: Articles 2, 3, 5, 6, 9, 10, 13, 14, 22, 25, 30, 32, 35, and 44; all applicability and legal conclusions require qualified deployment-specific review.

verified_facts: Neural Brain is product- and domain-neutral and has no accepted scoped customer or domain integration.
The current repository does not establish a concrete controller, processor, deployment, data-subject population, jurisdictional nexus, processing operation, or intended use.
The repository's protected Memory Core is an internal subsystem and cannot narrow the complete cognitive-system product boundary established by ADR-018.
unknown_facts_not_inferred: whether GDPR applies to a concrete deployment or processing operation
whether personal data, special-category data, criminal-offence data, profiling, or automated individual decision-making are processed
whether an Article 6 legal basis, Article 9 condition, Article 10 condition, transparency requirement, transfer mechanism, or other legal requirement applies
whether a concrete processing operation is likely to result in high risk and requires a DPIA
whether a concrete system may process personal data, be deployed, released, or operated

screening_template.assessment_unit: One immutable artifact version or digest, concrete proposed deployment and processing operation, intended purpose, and authenticated Tenant, Area, and Project scope combination.
deterministic_screening_order: Verify every required field, immutable artifact, authenticated scope binding, accountable owner, qualified reviewer, review date, rationale, verified evidence reference, and reassessment trigger; any missing, unknown, stale, contradictory, or scope-mismatched fact is incomplete.

Record Article 2 and Article 3 applicability evidence without reaching an applicability conclusion; absent or unresolved scope, establishment, offering, monitoring, or processing facts remain release blockers.

Screen special-category and criminal-offence data facts under Articles 9 and 10 before relying on a general processing description; unknown data classification or condition evidence remains a release blocker.

Screen profiling and solely automated individual decision facts under Article 22 independently; it neither creates authority nor compensates for missing privacy, security, control, recognition, or release evidence.

Screen Article 35 DPIA risk triggers and required assessments after the processing facts are complete; any unresolved high-risk trigger, missing qualified review, or missing required assessment remains a release blocker.

Record applicable-article candidates, required assessments, controls, transfer evidence, and release blockers for qualified review only; no completed screen is an allow, legal, compliance, authority, processing, deployment, or release outcome.

authority_boundary.template_is: a versioned governance and traceability input for separately governed qualified privacy review
template_is_not: a legal opinion, GDPR applicability determination, or compliance certification
a determination of lawfulness, Article 6 legal basis, Article 9 condition, Article 10 condition, Article 22 outcome, or DPIA necessity
a deployment, processing, productive-use, or release approval
an authority grant, policy decision, human approval, or Security Floor override
an authenticated Tenant, Area, Project, Session, or principal context
a protected-state transition request, gate decision, or runtime capability enablement
an implementation, maturity, recognition, safety, or production-autonomy claim
authority_boundary.release_boundary: Only separately authorized release governance, qualified applicable privacy review, and all Protected Control Plane, transition-gate, evaluation, recognition, and evidence requirements may decide a concrete processing operation or deployment. This template cannot activate a runtime path.

current_blocker.unblock_condition: A concrete proposed deployment supplies every required field, immutable artifact and scope evidence, qualified reviewer and rationale, verified evidence references, risk-trigger dispositions, required assessments, reassessment triggers, and independent release decision for separate governance evaluation.
current_blocker.next_step: Create one immutable screening record per proposed deployment artifact, processing operation, and Tenant, Area, and Project scope combination before any processing-specific or deployment-specific release decision.
